memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; walks unaided, manages stairs with rail, performs household chores without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds, within normal range.
medicines: 2 regular (alendronate, calcium+vitamin D). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Reports good mood, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Carer: Ramesh (husband).
goals: "Stay strong and continue working part‑time from home."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
alendronate sodium 70 mg tablet, take once weekly on empty stomach, morning, with full glass of water; remain upright 30 min.
calcium carbonate 500 mg tablet, take twice daily with meals; vitamin D3 400 IU included in same tablet.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (reference 8.5‑10.5).
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (reference 30‑100).
Comment: Vitamin D insufficient; consider supplementation.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: DEXA scan lumbar spine: T‑score -2.6 (osteoporosis). Hip T‑score -2.1. No vertebral fracture seen. Recommend continue antiresorptive therapy and ensure adequate calcium/vit D.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: No known drug allergies or intolerances.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent in ADLs; occasional mild knee discomfort after prolonged standing, but no limitation.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual schedule).
falls: No falls in the past 12 months; gait smooth; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (alendronate, calcium+vit D). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Mood stable, reports enjoying gardening.
carers: Carer: Ramesh (husband).
goals: "Keep active and avoid any falls."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
alendronate sodium 70 mg tablet, once weekly.
calcium carbonate 500 mg tablet with vitamin D3 400 IU, twice daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL (reference 8.5‑10.5).
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 28 ng/mL (reference 30‑100).
Comment: Vitamin D borderline; advise continue current dose.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; reports a minor slip at home two weeks ago, no injury, recovered quickly.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet.
falls: One fall in the last 12 months (minor slip, no injury); gait slightly cautious; timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds – raised fall risk.
medicines: 2 regular (alendronate, calcium+vit D). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Mood good, no depressive symptoms.
carers: Carer: Ramesh (husband).
goals: "Prevent future falls and stay confident on my feet." Plan: supervised balance exercises, wear supportive shoes, check home hazards.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
alendronate sodium 70 mg tablet, once weekly.
calcium carbonate 500 mg tablet with vitamin D3 800 IU, twice daily (increased vitamin D).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.5 mg/dL (reference 8.5‑10.5).
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 35 ng/mL (reference 30‑100).
Comment: Vitamin D now sufficient; continue current supplement.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having occasional lower back pain after sitting long hours at my desk. It eases with stretching but worries me about my spine.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for physiotherapy assessment on 2026-02-05 at 10:00 AM with Dr. S. Rao (Physiotherapy). Reason: evaluate back pain and provide core‑strengthening programme.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; back pain improved after physiotherapy, able to sit longer without discomfort.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen (<=2? actually score 3 >2, so negative? Wait positive screen is <=2. Score 3 is negative. But we need to follow rule: screen cognition with Mini‑Cog at first visit and once a year after that. A score of 2 or less out of 5 is recorded as a positive screen, with a plan for a fuller cognitive assessment. So we need to decide if we want positive or not. Let's make score 2 to trigger plan. We'll adjust.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (alendronate, calcium+vit D). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Mood good, denies anxiety.
carers: Carer: Ramesh (husband).
goals: "Maintain bone health and stay pain‑free." Plan: repeat DEXA in 2 years, continue current meds, consider referral to endocrinology if T‑score worsens.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.3 mg/dL (reference 8.5‑10.5).
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 38 ng/mL (reference 30‑100).
Comment: Vitamin D adequate; continue current supplementation.
